Account Numbers: New format, same C I F: add “00” in front, Old numbers usable during the transition, Longer format = more security. Cheque Books: Order new books within 182 days, Current leaves accepted meanwhile, Books 5 plus years old won't migrate. Statements: 0–12 months: instant via Corbit X, 12 months+: from secure backup, Cleaner, faster request process.

System Interface: today, Complex / static; with Corbit X, Modern / responsive. The gain: A better user experience.

name: t35a1c9b8
say: The road to go-live. Six phases take us from awareness to a stable new platform. Select a phase to see what it means for you and the materials that support it.

name: t2b1eb6bd
say: Phase 1, Awareness. Now, ongoing. Building understanding of what Corbit X is, why we are moving and what changes for customers and staff. What to focus on: Read the six Corbit X Staff Guides; Share the key messages in team huddles; Know where to find answers in the Knowledge Hub.

name: t1a590321
say: Phase 2, Training. Before go-live. Hands-on learning so every colleague can work confidently in Corbit X, including the new account-number look-up process. What to focus on: Complete your assigned training modules; Practise looking up new account numbers; Keep the quick reference cards close.

name: t8971a1ed
say: Phase 3, Readiness Testing. Go-live weekend. Live transaction and channel checks on the Sunday immediately before go-live, led by Branch Operations Supervisors with all branch staff participating. What to focus on: Test deposits, branch transactions, ATMs and the mobile app; Real transactions with real funds: follow controls; Do not close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday.

name: t8ce33bad
say: Phase 4, Go-Live. Go-live Monday. Corbit X opens for business. Continue the same branch day from Sunday and lead every interaction with a warm welcome. What to focus on: Run end of day at close of business on Monday; Start account-opening requests in Newgen; Smile. Check. Serve.

name: ta97f3eb0
say: Phase 5, Customer Support. First weeks after go-live. Helping customers through the change: new account numbers, cheques, chequebooks and account opening. What to focus on: Look up and share new account numbers at every interaction; Accept old-number cheques subject to the usual checks; Help customers with affected chequebooks find a way forward.

name: t7fcdaf68
say: Phase 6, Stabilization. Six months after go-live. Embedding new ways of working, closing out transition arrangements and building on the platform. What to focus on: Old-number cheques no longer accepted after six months; Keep encouraging use of new account numbers; Share feedback to help us improve.

name: ta06045d6
say: Frequently asked question. Will customers' old account numbers still work after go-live? Yes. Old account numbers will continue to be accepted for more than six months after go-live. Look up the new number in Corbit X using the process covered in training, serve the customer, and share the new number so they use it next time.

name: t28b61005
say: Frequently asked question. Can customers still use cheques that show their old account number? Yes, for six months after go-live, subject to the usual checks. After six months these cheques will no longer be accepted, so encourage customers to request new chequebooks early.

name: t3ddb80b5
say: Frequently asked question. What about chequebooks recorded more than five years ago? These chequebooks will not be migrated to Corbit X and can no longer be used. Affected customers have been notified. Explain the position with care, help them access funds through an approved alternative, and assist with a new chequebook where required.

name: t96643bc4
say: Frequently asked question. Can we open new accounts during the upgrade? Account opening is unavailable in Flexcube 11.1 and Corbit X during the static data freeze (the week before go-live) and for the first three days after go-live. Start the application in Newgen, receive deposits through the designated G L, and finalise from Thursday after go-live. Never turn a customer away.

name: tf7e688c3
say: Frequently asked question. What happens on the Sunday before go-live? Branch Operations Supervisors will open the branch day and all branch staff take part in live transaction and channel checks: deposits, branch transactions, ATMs, the mobile app and other instructed channels. These are real transactions with real funds. Do not close the branch day or run end of day on Sunday; continue into Monday and run end of day at close of business.

name: t396f8c18
say: Frequently asked question. What should I do if I'm not sure how to answer a customer? Pause and check before answering. Consult the relevant internal team, or find the guidebook or procedure in the repository. Never let a system change become a reason to turn a customer away.

name: t4258d4d2
say: Frequently asked question. Will new account numbers be printed for customers? Guidance on printing new account numbers will follow. Until then, look up and share the new number at every interaction.

name: t3a98d09a
say: Key dates and milestones. Calculated from the expected go-live date of Monday 8 February 2027. 1 February week: Static data freeze begins. Account opening unavailable in Flexcube 11.1 and Corbit X. Start applications in Newgen. Sunday, 7 February: Sunday live checks. Branch Operations Supervisors open the branch day; all staff run live transaction and channel checks. Monday, 8 February: Corbit X go-live. Continue Sunday's branch day; run end of day at close of business. Thursday, 11 February: Account opening resumes. Finalise pending applications and provide account numbers. 8 August 2027: Old-number cheques end. Cheques bearing old account numbers are no longer accepted. Dates will update automatically once the go-live date is confirmed.

name: tce4999bd
say: Coming to Corbit X. A platform built for what's next. Corbit X is more than a system change. Here's what it will make possible for our customers and for us.

name: te2a8cde2
say: What Corbit X will bring. Enhanced Customer Experience. Faster, smoother service at every touchpoint, so customers spend less time waiting and more time banking. Faster Account Opening. A streamlined onboarding journey that gets new customers up and running sooner. Improved Branch Operations. Simpler processes and less manual effort, freeing branch teams to focus on customers. Unified Customer View. One complete picture of every customer, wherever you serve them. Better Reporting and Analytics. Clearer, timelier insight to support smarter decisions. Modern Banking Platform. A scalable, resilient core built for growth and innovation. Digital Self-Service Features. More ways for customers to bank on their own terms, any time.
